19.message:
fix(1.8): resolve TileState reflectively to stop NoClassDefFoundError on every block break

org.bukkit.block.TileState is a 1.14+ class; referencing it directly in
isValidBreakEvent crashed BlockBreakListener on 1.8.8 for every block break.
Now resolved via Class.forName, short-circuiting to false when absent.
19.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

21.message:
feat(i18n): translate tinker tools/armour/parts via ItemTextResolver, retire re-skin listener

Assembled tinker items are named+lored from their PDC at runtime; they now route through core's

24.message:
fix(guide): defer guide-type categorisation until the item registry finalizes

ItemGroups#categorise() iterated group.getItems() directly from
onEnable(), but core only links a SlimefunItem into its ItemGroup via
load(), which runs for every item on the first tick after all addons
enable. Every group was still empty at that point, so no item ever
got a declared guide type and everything fell back to Misc (or an
unrelated heuristic match). Run categorise() from a listener on
SlimefunItemRegistryFinalizedEvent instead, fired right after that
loop completes.
24.author: intisy (Finn Birich)

25.message:
feat(smeltery): auto-build the seared structure around a placed controller

Placing the smeltery controller (by hand or cheated) only ever placed that
one block, leaving the player to hand-place all 6 seared bricks, the tank
and the spout - unlike a core multiblock, whose place-to-build assembler
builds its whole structure from a single placement. The smeltery was never
a core MultiBlockMachine (it validates its structure by counting BlockStorage
ids around the controller on menu-open, in TinkersSmeltery), so that
assembler never ran for it.

Hooks the same core-side generic assembler (MultiBlockAssembler.assembleAround)
onto the controller's placement instead, at MONITOR priority so it only runs
once the controller's own placement/permission checks already passed. Builds
the exact block counts TinkersSmeltery#validateMultiblock already expects.
25.author: intisy (Finn Birich)
